emerging_watch: Watching whether Base Metals & Copper's mean-revert Hurst tag leads to a confirmed handoff to Oil & Gas Producers: specifically, if Base Metals' momentum score drops below Oil & Gas by more than 0.2 for 5 consecutive sessions on the detector, I will retire the two-narrative-fight view and read Oil & Gas as the single leader.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas is the only top-3 theme with a 'mixed' rather than 'mean-revert' Hurst tag, the highest durability_bar (0.61) among leaders, and the strongest breadth (0.571), suggesting the trend is broader and less prone to sharp reversal than the mean-reverting Base Metals leader above it. The absolute-trend gate is the one validated leg and it favors eligible themes with durable trends.
